noticias.titulo: CoreWeave shares are sinking. Buy the dip, Deutsche Bank says - CNBC
noticias.resumo: CoreWeave is sliding in spite of its strong fundamentals, and investors should take advantage of the discount on shares, according to Deutsche Bank.  The investment bank has a buy on the cloud infrastructure stock.  It also has a $150 price target on shares, implying 128% upside from Wednesday's close.

noticias.resumo:
Oct 14 (Reuters) - Hotter-than-expected inflation data sent the Nasdaq ​to a sharply lower close on Wednesday, with worries about more interest rate hikes from the Federal Reserve pummeling ‌shares of Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sensitive to higher borrowing costs. 

Increased bets that the Fed will need more rate hikes to tame inflation dealt a sharp blow to some of the market's biggest gainers of 2026.  Oracle (ORCL.

noticias.titulo: Micron Stock Slides Again Thursday: What's Going On? - Benzinga
Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: CoreWeave, Rocket Lab Corp, SK Hynix & more - CNBC
noticias.resumo: Check out the companies making the biggest moves premarket: CoreWeave — Shares of the cloud infrastructure technology company fell for a second day, losing 6% on Thursday as investors worry that CoreWeave, along with other technology companies, are borrowing too much for an artificial intelligence build-out.  Rocket Lab — The space company dropped nearly 10% after it delayed the launch of its Neutron rocket to 2027.  SK Hynix — Shares for the Korea-based company slid over 7% as investors are concerned over funding the artificial intelligence build-out.
